purpose: Independent longitudinal replication of the frozen post-capitulation event detector with market-episode dependence controls.

dependence_control.per_asset_overlap: collapse signals until the forecast horizon matures
dependence_control.utc_market_blocks: group all selected asset signals by UTC 24h block
dependence_control.rolling_market_episodes: merge selected signals separated by no more than 24h
dependence_control.episode_label: hit when more than half of the selected assets rise over the horizon

selection_policy: No threshold, symbol, horizon, direction, or gate may be changed after downloading this dataset. Failed gates remain reported.
